column1: # FICTIONAL DEMO DATA for Ad Creative Academy Course 804. Brisa is not a real brand.

column6: review_text
Day 5 I almost gave up. Day 9 I stopped thinking about my armpits entirely. Nobody tells you the first week is weird, but Brisa did, and that's why I stayed.
I have tried NINE natural deodorants. Nine. Every single one with baking soda gave me a rash that looked like a burn. This is the first one that doesn't. I could cry.
Works well, lasts through my 10-hour shifts at the hospital. Only lost a star because the refill ran out faster than I expected, about 5 weeks.
I have a 4pm team meeting every day and I used to sit there with my arms glued to my sides. Now I don't even think about it.
Smells amazing and works fine but the case hinge feels a bit flimsy. Mine cracked after two months. Customer service sent a new one though, so fair.
My boyfriend stole mine. Then he bought his own. Then he stole mine again.
The first two weeks I smelled worse than ever. I get that it's the adjustment thing but I work in sales, I can't smell for two weeks. Stopped using it.
I cycle 14km to work. I shower at the office but I used to still smell by lunch. Not anymore. Genuinely didn't think natural could do this.
Lovely product, the scent is subtle, not perfume-y. Would be 5 stars if refills were a bit cheaper.
Pregnant and reading every label like a detective. Short ingredient list, no fragrance, no drama. Exactly what I needed.
Ordered in October and it was out of stock but the site let me order anyway. Waited three weeks. Refunded but annoyed.
No white marks on my black work dresses. That alone is worth it.
Put it on right after shaving and it didn't sting. Every other natural one burned. Wish the site said this clearly, I was scared to try.
I'm a nurse. Twelve-hour shifts, masks, stress. This is the first deodorant I've used that is still working at hour ten.
Good but not magic. On really hot days I reapply at lunch. Still better than the last three I tried.
The refill system is so satisfying. Click, done. I've stopped buying plastic sticks entirely.
My husband and I both use this one. The smell is not girly, not manly, just clean. Would like a bigger size.
I have hidradenitis-prone skin and I'm super careful. This one hasn't caused a single flare. Talked to my dermatologist first, she said go for it.
Works, but the paper refill got soft in my humid bathroom and was hard to push up. Keep it out of the shower room.
Smells like a holiday. My colleague asked what perfume I was wearing. It was my deodorant.
Took about 8 days for my body to adjust. After that it's been great. The day-by-day guide email helped a lot.
As a physio I'm close to people all day. This is the first natural one I trust at work.
Scent fades after a few hours but protection lasts. I'd like the scent to be a bit stronger.
I bought it because of the case colors honestly. I stayed because it works. The coral one lives in my gym bag.
Gave me red bumps after 3 days. Maybe I'm allergic to something in it. Switched back.
I've been through the 'detox your pits' nonsense with other brands. Brisa just told me what would happen and when. Honest brand.
Subscription is easy to skip, which I appreciate. Less easy to find the skip button on mobile.
Hot yoga three times a week. Still fresh on the drive home. My car thanks you.
I stopped carrying a spare deodorant in my bag. That's how I know it works.
Works well but it's a bit hard to apply when it's cold, you have to warm it against your skin for a second.
I teach 30 teenagers all day. If there's a smell, they will tell you. They have not told me.
Love it. Please bring it back in stock, I'm on my last refill and rationing it like it's gold.
After chemo my skin reacts to everything. This doesn't. Thank you for making something gentle that still works.
Refill arrived two weeks late to Hawaii, second time now. Product is fine, shipping isn't.
The calendar ad got me. 'Day one, day three, day seven.' It happened exactly like that.
Stays on through a full wedding day of dancing. Reapplied once before the speeches, just in case.
Men's deodorant always smelled like a locker room to me. This smells like nothing, which is the point.
It's good but $28 for the starter kit is a lot when you're not sure it'll work. Glad I tried it though.
Menopause hot flashes are no joke. This is the only natural one that keeps up.
Bought it after reading the reviews from people with sensitive skin. Can confirm. Only 4 stars because I miss having a scent.
I work in a restaurant kitchen. 40 degrees by the grill. Still works. I'm shocked.
Didn't work for me at all. By noon I could smell myself. Maybe my body chemistry. Returned it and they refunded fast, at least.
I love that the refills are paper. My bathroom bin used to be full of plastic deodorant sticks.
Great on sensitive skin. Would love a travel size for my carry-on.
Summer in Texas. 100 degrees. Walked the dog at noon. Came home, still fine. That's the review.
First week I smelled a bit more than usual, exactly like they warned. After that, zero issues. Trust the process.
It works but I don't love the texture, it's a bit sticky at first. Dries fine after a minute.
My 4pm client pitches used to come with a side of panic. Now it's just the normal kind of panic.
Solid. I run in the morning, shower, put it on, and I'm fine until evening. The case feels premium.
I ignored all the 'natural' deodorants because I thought they didn't work. My sister made me try this. She was right, annoyingly.
Fine but not better than my old one, and more expensive. Might go back.
The 'your first week' guide should be required reading. It saved me from quitting on day 4.
Best scent of the four. Please make it permanent.
Mail carrier here. 20,000 steps a day. Works.
Good product, but the subscription emails are a bit much. Three emails for one shipment.
Eczema under my arms for years. Two months with Brisa and it's calmed down. Not saying it's medicine, just saying it doesn't make it worse.
My teenage son uses it now too. Took some convincing because the case is 'too pretty'. He chose Sage.
I stopped checking my armpits in the bathroom at work. If you know, you know.
Bought it for the refill idea, stayed because it's genuinely the best one I've used.
Great, but the site should say more clearly which one is for sensitive skin. Took me a while to figure out it's Unscented.
